You are agent A. Choose exactly one task for yourself.
This is a fresh allocation round. All tasks are initially unclaimed. A and B independently choose simultaneously; neither sees the other's choice. These choices are final. Each valid assignment earns 100 minus its execution cost. Each extra claimant to a duplicate task incurs 200, shared equally among that task's claimants. Priority bonus is zero.
